description: Published Xometry sheet-metal capabilities and design tips from an owner-supplied research snapshot (2026-10-23). Second-hand and provisional: every rule is non-blocking and can never produce a 'compatible' verdict.

research.notes: Data supplied by the project owner from an external research session; this project's build environment could not reach xometry.com. Full downloadable design guides were not extracted. Ambiguous datums (hole-to-hole, bend-edge-to-hole, countersink, relief) are left disabled. Supplier/process-specific capability needs quote confirmation. Electrical suitability and certification are not assessed.
